adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, email sending is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(...) } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }` and the handler still returns `{ message: "Guests added" }`. On the client (`AddGuestsDialog`), `onSuccess` always shows `showToast(t("guests_added"), "success")`. So email delivery failures would be silently ignored (no error details logged, no propagation to UI), even though guests are added successfully. This is a real, diff-grounded reliability/observability concern rather than a strict correctness bug in adding guests.
